segmentation.text: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is a defined term whose admitted aggregate is DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'driver' is a role read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency narrowing).

'back' is moving backward, drv.motion.moving_backward ('the component of a's velocity along a's heading ... below minus speed_tol'), read from kinematics as kin.gear's contract requires. 'into an intersection' is the footprint coming to overlap an intersection r (st.intersection, 'the region where two roadways meet'; rel.occupies true at the observation, false at the previous one) while backing; the crosswalk and the stop line are not stand-ins for it, as st.intersection's contract says. 'on or over a crosswalk' is the backing vehicle's footprint overlapping a st.crosswalk ('marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection'). 'around a street corner': the corner is where two streets meet; backing around it carries the vehicle through the area 'embraced within the prolongation ... of the lateral curb lines' of the meeting ways (DEF-NRS-484A-105), the st.intersection region, while its heading turns — read as backing with the footprint overlapping r, the heading having changed by at least the turn threshold since the backing within r began (Term.headingSince, integrated from kin.yaw_rate).

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that is backing at the observation: drv.motion.moving_backward(subject) with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance.
obligation: At the observation, none of: (a) for some intersection r (st.intersection), the subject's footprint overlaps r and did not at the previous observation (rel.occupies) — it backs into r; (b) for some crosswalk x (st.crosswalk), the footprint overlaps x (rel.occupies); (c) for some intersection r, the footprint overlaps r and the magnitude of Term.headingSince(subject, p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph, ψ) is at least p.turn_heading_min, where ψ = drv.motion.moving_backward(subject) and rel.occupies(subject, r): since it last began backing within r its heading has turned at least by the turn threshold — it backs around the corner.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever or whatever controls it.
'back into an intersection' is read as the entry into the intersection while backing; backing straight out of an intersection the vehicle is already in is not backing into it.

'around a street corner' is read through the intersection region the corner bounds, with a heading change of at least p.turn_heading_min while backing within it; the city-limit qualifier of 'street' (DEF-NRS-484A-265) is not read, every intersection's corners being treated as street corners.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car backs at 2 m/s along a street and its footprint comes to overlap the intersection while backing.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A car backs at 2 m/s mid-block, away from any intersection or crosswalk.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car drives forward through an intersection and over its crosswalks without ever backing.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car's footprint comes to overlap an intersection while the source supplies no velocity, so whether it was backing is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A car backs over a marked mid-block crosswalk: its footprint overlaps the crosswalk while backing.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A car that overshot into the intersection backs straight out of it, heading unchanged, on an approach with no crosswalk: it is not entering the intersection and its heading has not turned.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: A car standing within the intersection backs around the corner into the cross street, its heading turning 80 degrees while its footprint still overlaps the intersection.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; speed resolution of the acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change over the turn window at which a change of course counts as a turn rather than a lane change or a drift
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_080_o1; turning-movement classification in trajectory analysis
